dialogues.speaker: Slothsheep Observation Log
dialogues.text: "Slothsheep carrying kuuvahki seed cores consistently maintain a certain distance from others of their kind. This behavior suggests they may be the result of atypical development caused by the Solaris Core and Nycalyx."

dialogues.speaker: Slothsheep Observation Log
dialogues.text: "To test this hypothesis, we have to regularly return stray Slothsheep to this location."
